audit.why: Illaoi is 54.58% over 1092 games into Dr. Mundo and the packet level chart gives her every stage but the last. Difficulty 6/10 and the EVEN label overstate his side slightly but sit inside the honest band, so only the chart rows were moved.
audit.corrected: Lane framing kept: Illaoi controls levels 1-6 and the first-item window; the last stage is skill-dependent, not a Mundo win.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..6].side and win[2..6] handed levels 3-5 to 'Skill' and levels 6 through two-items to Dr. Mundo, contradicting the packet chart, the 54.58% win rate and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror set the chart to Illaoi x6 then Skill at two-plus items. Both layers must agree row for row or the page prints two answers, so the flips are proposed as one atomic pair-set with ratings rescaled.
audit.corrected: Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill across win[] and phases[].side, ratings 7/6/7/7/7/6/5, and the why-text for rows 3-7 rewritten so it stops promising a flip that does not happen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Infected Bonesaw 'self-damaging' and 'health-cost', which Riot's description does not state; it also credited Mundo with 'ignoring your CC' and never named Test of Spirit's Vessel condition, Harsh Lesson's 4s dash-reset, Heart Zapper's stored-damage heal, or Leap of Faith spawning a tentacle per champion hit.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says only: damage based on the target's current health plus a slow, at 975 range on a 4s cooldown — no health cost appears in the kit data (cost 0). Heart Zapper (W, 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s) stores damage taken and heals a portion of it on the burst, which is the real anti-heal target; Maximum Dosage (R, 120s) heals a percent of missing health and gives move speed but grants no peel. Mundo's passive resists the first immobilizing effect, and Illaoi applies none, so 'ignores your CC' was noise.
audit.corrected: Named Heart Zapper's 15-17s cooldown as the fight window, the stored-damage heal as the Grievous Wounds target, Maximum Dosage's missing-health heal with no peel at 6, Harsh Lesson's 4s dash-reset, Test of Spirit's Vessel condition, and Leap of Faith spawning a tentacle per champion hit. Removed the unverifiable self-damage claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heart Zapper was tracked but never given a number.
audit.why: A concrete 15-17s window tells the player how long the punish lasts.
audit.corrected: Cooldown stated in phases[3].why, phases[5].why and whys[3].

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already core in report[8]; the missingInteractions anti-heal rule is now echoed in spikes[2] and spikes[3] where the sustain claim actually lives.

notes: Removed the 'self-damaging Q' / 'health-cost cleaver' claim: Riot's Infected Bonesaw text states only current-health damage plus a slow, and the kit lists cost 0. Any real health cost is unverifiable from the kits, so nothing was asserted either way. Also removed 'he ignores your CC entirely' from late — Mundo's passive resists the first immobilizing effect and Illaoi applies none (E slows, R grounds), so the sentence described an interaction that does not occur. The generator flags Leap of Faith with 'untargetable' and 'grounding' while Riot's description mentions neither; per the calibration rule nothing about untargetability was written.
